Lemony Marinade
By: Carissa
Published: Thursday, June 23, 2011 - 1:04pm

Ingredients




1/2 lemon
1 teaspoon olive oil
1/4 teaspoon sea salt
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
splash of balsalmic vinegar
of Italian seasoning

Preparation

1 Zest and juice the lemon half, combining both zest and juice in a bowl. 2 Add remaining ingredients and whisk until combined. 3 Brush over veggies while grilling. 4 Be sure to coat them on both sides, repeating each time you turn over the veggies.
